rules.sentence: Findings such as Q waves (old MI), primary repolarization abnormalities (recent MI), left ventricular hypertrophy (longstanding hypertension), and complete left bundle branch block (hypertension or dilated cardiomyopathy) should prompt formal cardiology referral.
